Without Bluetooth permission the app cannot talk to the board.
Turn on Bluetooth on this device to connect to the board.
Android will ask for the board\'s 6-digit PIN. It is shown on the serial console at boot and on the ESP32 web page (Settings).
Tap “Find board”, choose your WTTC and enter its PIN. You only do this once: after that the app connects by itself when the board is nearby.
Test notification sent: check Telegram in a few seconds

The Webasto does not answer on the W-Bus. Check the bus wire, the common ground and the TJA1020 module.
The board\'s clock is not set: schedules will not run.
No answer on the W-Bus; without keep-alive it switches itself off.
Demo mode: the data is simulated and nothing is sent to any board.
They switch on by themselves at a set time and days; the board stores them.

At most once a day: versions, device type, country, number of starts and faults. No location, names, networks or PIN, and your IP is not stored.
WTTC app %1$s · wttc.favala.es\nFree software, GPL v3 or later licence · github.com/matatunos/wttc\nCode generated entirely with Claude (Anthropic)

WTTC can send, at most once a day: app and firmware version, Android version, device type (phone, tablet or radio), country from the system language, number of starts and stops, and fault codes.

Location, names, Wi-Fi networks, PIN and schedules are never sent, and your IP is not stored. The results are public at wttc.favala.es/estadisticas.php.

You can change your mind at any time in “App settings”, at the bottom of the screen.
Reset the last run, the month and the total? The estimate comes from the power reported by the Webasto (≈ 0.62 l/h at full load) and can be off by 20%.
The app will stop connecting to this board. To pair it again, also remove it in Android\'s Bluetooth settings and search for it again.
Pending changes are applied. If it is heating, the board does not restart.
Saved. It will apply after restarting the board (“Restart board”).

The board\'s Wi-Fi still has the factory password, which is public: anyone nearby could control the heater from the web page. Choose a new one (at least 8 characters). It applies when the board restarts.

At most once a day, when opened, the app checks the latest version at wttc.favala.es (it sends nothing about you).
Automatic board updates (at boot and once a day, with a network with internet)
The board found a new firmware version: %1$s (it has %2$s).\n\nThe board downloads it, checks that it is official, installs it and restarts by itself. The heater must be off.
When the board\'s web page is opened from another network (home, campsite…), a user and password are asked for. The factory ones are wttc / wttc: change them.
⚠ The web still has the factory user and password (wttc / wttc).

Every run is recorded on the board. If you turn this on, the board (or this app, if the board has no internet) sends it and you see it with charts on wttc.favala.es with the code. Without the code nobody can see them.
Installation code (when changing boards, enter the old one)
Code sent: check Telegram in a few seconds

The board records every run: hours, fuel, inside temperature and humidity, battery and faults. If you turn this on, you will see it with charts and tips on wttc.favala.es (how early to start depending on the cold, how much you spend a month, whether the battery suffers…).\n\nOnly with your board\'s code; nobody else can see it, and it is deleted whenever you want. It can be changed in Settings → My statistics.
Do not unplug it or touch anything: when it finishes it restarts by itself and the app reconnects.

Diagnostic mode (log, technical data and crash report)

“Webasto” button in Android\'s quick settings (pull them down and edit them to add it) and a home screen widget. Tapping it connects to the board and switches on for this long, or off if it is already on.
The board cannot be found. Get closer to the van or open the app.
